task_set_rationale: T2/T3/T4 are the tasks reported in Casademunt Gonzalez (2023), including Appendix III. Their joint fusion is our adaptation, not a reported thesis ensemble. Fixed before new model evaluation; no search over task subsets.

transfer.preprocess: lpq.preprocess foreground crop, square white padding, bilinear resize
transfer.head: training-only standardized, balanced L2 logistic regression

validation.selection: Per-task hyperparameters maximize mean of three inner-fold macro F1 values. One global encoding per method/task set maximizes the unweighted mean of those task scores. First declared candidate and encoding break ties.
validation.fusion: fixed majority of available task labels; ties assigned to PD; no selection, calibration or weighting
validation.primary_endpoint: participant-level macro F1 after majority fusion over T2/T3/T4, averaged over five repetitions after pooling outer folds
validation.primary_family: all six method pairs at T2/T3/T4 participant fusion
validation.secondary_families: six pairs separately at each other endpoint; four within-method T2/T3/T4-versus-all8 fusion contrasts
validation.task_specific_results: descriptive; no best-task selection or additional significance claims
validation.uncertainty: diagnosis-stratified participant bootstrap and participant-wise paired prediction swaps, keeping all repeats/tasks together; pointwise intervals conditional on saved predictions

scope: Competitive reference baselines, not exact reproductions of Drotar or Diaz. No external cohort. No new XAI analysis. Previously inspected PaHaW outcomes motivated this extension; nested splits do not make it independent confirmation.
